columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Identifier that groups data into a batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Used to link with rows in the error table

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the record to be processed

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row, such as Insert, Update, etc.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File Record Number. Record indicator in the File.

columns.name: REUSABLE_URL_EXT_REF
columns.description: Reusable URL External Reference - Stores the unique identifier of the reusable URL in the source system.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: This field stores the different types of categories for the reusable urls.  Reference MKT_URL_CATEGORY lookups.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This field identifies whether the reusable url is active or not.  Reference MKT_URL_STATUS lookups.

columns.name: URL_ID
columns.description: URL Id is the marketing URL id.

columns.name: URL_NAME
columns.description: URL Name is the marketing URL name.

columns.name: URL_DESC
columns.description: URL Description is the marketing URL description.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: URL is the hyperlink for the marketing URL.

columns.name: URL_TYPE
columns.description: URL type.  Identifies whether a URL is TRACKABLE_URL or REUSABLE_URL or RESPONSE_FORMS.  Reference MKT_URL_TYPE lookups.

columns.name: CREATE_RESP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if response needs to be created.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
